description: Resource attributes for outgoing webhook consumers, endpoints, messages, delivery attempts, and provider portal sessions.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant identifier. Used by islamuevent_tenant_admin derived role.

organizationId.description: Owning organization identifier. Used by islamuevent_org_admin derived role for organization-owned webhook resources.

allowOrganizationWebhooks.description: Whether tenant policy delegates organization-owned webhook management to organization admins.

provider.description: Optional provider name, such as local or svix.
